title: 第1章 废物陆凡
content_zh:
偌大的广场之中，人头攒动。一块高达两丈的墨石傲然立于中央，墨石之上，硕大的武道二字，摄人心魄。

今天，正是武安国武道学院招生之日，整个江临城十八岁以下的年轻人皆可报名，只要测试合格，便可进入武道学院修行三年，成为人人敬仰的武者。

随着检测员一声叫喊，由人群之中走出一名十七岁的年轻人。他身躯瘦弱，面容清秀，身着白色武道服，胸口有着江临城陆家的标志。

脚步缓慢，陆凡走到墨石之前，摆好了架势，眼眸之中满是坚定。

立于一旁的武道学院老师微微点头，他很喜欢陆凡的眼神，很有力量。

一拳，陆凡击中面前的墨石，霎时墨石光芒亮起，显露出一行文字，让广场众人清晰得见。

广场上顿时响起一片嘲讽之声。原本看好他的武道学院老师也是皱起眉头。

“才炼体三重也上来丢人，是要笑死我吗？”

“这不是陆家的废材陆凡吗？怎么几年过去了，他还是炼体三重。真是废材啊！”

“他已经快十八了吧，估计他这辈子都无法练出罡劲了。”

“下来吧，别丢人了，你们陆家的人都快被你个废材丢完了。”

一声声的嘲讽夹杂着讥笑，陆凡暗暗咬牙，捏紧的拳头都因太过用力，指甲深深陷入了肉中。转头，陆凡向坐在一旁的父亲看去，这个被称为陆家罡虎的男人一脸失望之色。

一声叹息仿佛在陆凡的耳边响起，咬紧牙关，陆凡走了下来。

检测员继续叫人，一名与陆凡差不多年纪的年轻人走了出来，同时撞了陆凡的肩膀一下，嘲弄道：“废物，让你看看什么叫武者。”

陆凡被撞的一个趔趄，但却没有发作。一言不发，走到一边。走到墨石前的陆明用力挥出一拳，一声闷响，墨石爆出光芒。

蓦地，人群发出惊叹之声，连带着检测员此时都忍不住叫喊起来。

陆凡转头看着墨石之上闪亮无比的炼体八重几个字，瞳孔收缩。四周的群众开始啧啧赞叹起来。

“炼体八重啊，陆家的陆明真厉害，我看下一任陆家家主就是他了吧。”

“那是肯定，比起他的废物堂弟，陆明才是当仁不让的人选，看看人家的武道修为！”

“我看不用多久他就能练出罡劲了。到时候我们江临城又多一位武者。”

“陆明简直是我们江临城的骄傲。”

得意的陆明已经张开了双臂，接受众人的欢呼。坐在一旁的武道学院老师也轻轻鼓掌，他们又将多收一位学员。十八岁，炼体八重，这个成绩算是勉强合格。

而在陆明下来之后，检测员再度念出下一人的名字。

一名婉约的美女走了出来，身着长裙，但却美艳惊人。

朱唇杏口，美目流转，腰盈盈一握，发漆黑如瀑。张月涵走到墨石之前，一掌拍在墨石之上。

清晰可闻的碎裂之声响起，而后墨石闪亮起光辉。

在场众人无不倒吸一口凉气。武道学院的老师此时已经站了起来，目光死死盯住张月涵，终于找到一个好苗子了。

张家的家主已经笑的合不拢嘴，旁边两位家主开始抱拳向张家主道喜，得此一女，家门可兴。

“炼体九重啊，张月涵真厉害，你是我的女神。”

“原来我们城最厉害的是张月涵啊，这一次张家要崛起了。”

“张月涵，你是我们女人的偶像。”

歇斯底里的叫喊声响起，张月涵脸上带着笑容，向众人鞠躬行礼。美目扫视全场。陆明也在人群之中鼓掌，一脸欣慰。但张月涵在目光与陆凡相接的时候，却眼神略有波动，而后别过头去。

陆凡顿觉不妙，这时张月涵已经走了下来，并且向着人群外走去。

陆凡连忙跟上，拐弯抹角之后，在一个无人的小巷之中，张月涵终于停下了脚步。

陆凡也听了下来，看着有些不敢抬头看他的张月涵，陆凡出声道：“月涵，你怎么了。”

张月涵咬了咬嘴唇，像是下定了决心一般，抬起头道：“陆凡，我们不能在一起了。”

陆凡只觉得如遭重击，没有人知道，他与张月涵已经暗中交往了三年。

“因为，我考上武道学院了。从今天开始，我们的身份将天差地别。我将成为一名武者，而你。。。。”

张月涵的话语已经带上了决绝，根本不管她的话语有多么刺伤陆凡。

陆凡已经感觉自己的身躯有些颤抖，道：“而我只是一个废物对吗？”

张月涵没有回答，但她的眼神却已经给了陆凡答案。

陆凡接着道：“你能考上武道学院，也是因为我。”

张月涵咬牙道：“我知道。你给我的那些药材，我以后都会还给你的。等我到了武道学院，我一定给你带回更好的药材，到时候我们就两清了。”

陆凡退后两步，仿佛已经不认识了面前的女子。

张月涵从怀中摸出一块玉佩，这是陆凡送给她的礼物。

陆凡记得那个夜晚，张月涵躺在他的怀里，笑盈盈的接过玉佩，满脸幸福。

但现在，张月涵上前将玉佩塞回到陆凡的手上，道：“陆凡，我希望你出去以后不要跟别人说我们之间的恋情，就当是你最后为我做的事情好吗？”

陆凡死死的捏着手中的玉佩，道：“你放心，我们从未交往过。”

言毕，陆凡将手中的玉佩狠狠的摔在地上。张月涵目光闪烁，但也未将玉佩拾起，退后几步，张月涵道：“陆凡，现实一点吧。你也知道，我们之前是不可能的了，再见。”

张月涵仿佛不愿再跟陆凡多说一句，快步离去。

陆凡看着她的背影，脑中无法将当初在他身边的那个可爱女子与面前的这个女人重叠。

当初张月涵和他在一起的时候可没有说过这句话。他将自己舍不得吃的药材偷偷给她的时候，她也没说这句话。

陆凡站在原地许久，天空忽的飘落飞雪。

陆凡失魂落魄的走回广场，此时其他人还测试的不亦乐乎。

蓦地，陆凡看到了远处正在与他的堂兄陆明说说笑笑的张月涵，并且这时，陆明居然还将自己的剑送给了她，张月涵略带害羞的欣然收下。

心中升起无限悲凉，陆凡轻笑一声转身离去。

content_en:
The huge square was crowded with people.A two-foot-tall ink stone stands proudly in the center. On top of the ink stone, the huge words "Martial Dao" are breathtaking.

Today is the enrollment day for the Wu'an National Martial Arts Academy. Young people under the age of 18 across Jiang Lincheng can sign up. As long as they pass the test, they can enter the Martial Arts Academy to practice for three years and become a warrior respected by everyone.

As the inspector shouted, a seventeen-year-old young man walked out of the crowd.He has a thin body and a delicate face. He is wearing a white martial arts uniform and has the symbol of Jiang Lincheng's Lu family on his chest.

With slow steps, Lu Fan walked up to Mo Shi and took a stance, his eyes full of determination.

The teacher from the martial arts academy standing aside nodded slightly. He liked Lu Fan's eyes very much, they were very powerful.

With one punch, Lu Fan hit the ink stone in front of him. The ink stone suddenly lit up, revealing a line of text, which was clearly visible to everyone in the square.

There was a burst of ridicule in the square.The martial arts academy teacher who was originally optimistic about him also frowned.

"You're just at the third level of body refining and you're here to embarrass me. Are you trying to laugh me to death?"

"Isn't this the good-for-nothing Lu Fan of the Lu family? How come several years have passed and he is still at the third level of body refining. What a good-for-nothing!"

"He is almost 18 years old. I guess he will never be able to practice Gang Jin in this life."

"Come down, don't be embarrassed, all of you in the Lu family are almost ruined by you, this good-for-nothing."

There were sneers mixed with sneers, Lu Fan secretly gritted his teeth, his clenched fists were too hard, and his nails dug deeply into his flesh.Turning his head, Lu Fan looked at his father sitting beside him. The man known as Lu Jiaganghu had a disappointed look on his face.

A sigh seemed to ring in Lu Fan's ears, gritting his teeth, Lu Fan walked down.

The inspector continued to call for help, and a young man about the same age as Lu Fan came out. At the same time, he bumped Lu Fan's shoulder and said mockingly: "Trash, let me show you what a warrior is."

Lu Fan staggered after being hit, but did not have an attack.Without saying a word, he stepped aside.Lu Ming walked up to the ink stone and punched hard. There was a muffled sound and the ink stone exploded with light.

Suddenly, the crowd let out a sound of exclamation, and even the inspector couldn't help shouting at this time.

Lu Fan turned his head and looked at the words "Eight Levels of Body Refining" that were shining brightly on the ink stone, and his pupils shrank.The people around him began to admire him.

"Eighth level of body refining, Lu Ming of the Lu family is really powerful. I think he will be the next head of the Lu family."

"That's for sure. Compared to his good-for-nothing cousin, Lu Ming is the obvious candidate. Look at his martial arts skills!"

"I don't think it will take long for him to be able to practice Gang Jin. Then we will have another warrior in Jiang Lincheng."

"Lu Ming is simply the pride of our Jiang Lincheng."

The proud Lu Ming had opened his arms and accepted the cheers from everyone.The teachers from the martial arts academy sitting aside also applauded gently, they were about to accept one more student.Eighteen years old, eighth level of physical training, this result is considered to be barely qualified.

After Lu Ming came down, the inspector read out the next person's name again.

A graceful beauty walked out, wearing a long dress, but stunningly beautiful.

Her lips are red and apricot-mouthed, her beautiful eyes are flowing, her waist is full and her hair is as black as a waterfall.Zhang Yuehan walked up to the ink stone and slapped it with her palm.

There was a clearly audible sound of shattering, and then the ink stone shone brightly.

Everyone present took a deep breath.The teacher from the Martial Arts Academy had already stood up, staring intently at Zhang Yuehan, finally finding a good candidate.

The head of the Zhang family was already smiling from ear to ear, and the two heads of the family next to him began to congratulate the head of the Zhang family with fists in their hands. With this daughter, the family will be prosperous.

"Ninth level of body training, Zhang Yuehan is so amazing, you are my goddess."

"It turns out that the most powerful person in our city is Zhang Yuehan. This time the Zhang family is about to rise."

"Zhang Yuehan, you are our women's idol."

Hysterical shouts rang out, and Zhang Yuehan bowed to everyone with a smile on her face.Beautiful eyes scanned the whole place.Lu Ming also applauded among the crowd, with a look of relief on his face.But when Zhang Yuehan's eyes met Lu Fan's, her eyes fluctuated slightly, and then she looked away.

Lu Fan suddenly felt something was wrong. At this time, Zhang Yuehan had already walked down and walked towards the crowd.

Lu Fan quickly followed, and after beating around the bush, Zhang Yuehan finally stopped in a deserted alley.

Lu Fan also listened. Looking at Zhang Yuehan who was afraid to look up at him, Lu Fan said, "Yuehan, what's wrong with you?"

Zhang Yuehan bit her lip, as if she had made up her mind, she raised her head and said, "Lu Fan, we can't be together anymore."

Lu Fan only felt like he had been hit hard. No one knew that he and Zhang Yuehan had been secretly dating for three years.

"Because, I have been admitted to the martial arts academy. From today on, our identities will be completely different. I will become a warrior, and you..."

Zhang Yuehan's words were filled with determination, no matter how much her words hurt Lu Fan.

Lu Fan already felt his body trembling a little, and said, "And I'm just a waste, right?"

Zhang Yuehan didn't answer, but her eyes gave Lu Fan the answer.

Lu Fan continued: "You were able to get into the martial arts academy because of me."

Zhang Yuehan gritted her teeth and said: "I know. I will return the medicinal materials you gave me to you in the future. When I get to the Martial Arts Academy, I will definitely bring you better medicinal materials, and then we will be clear."

Lu Fan took two steps back, as if he no longer recognized the woman in front of him.

Zhang Yuehan took out a jade pendant from her arms, which was a gift given to her by Lu Fan.

Lu Fan remembered that night, Zhang Yuehan was lying in his arms, taking the jade pendant with a smile on her face, her face full of happiness.

But now, Zhang Yuehan stepped forward and put the jade pendant back into Lu Fan's hand, saying, "Lu Fan, I hope you won't tell others about our love affair after you go out. Just treat it as the last thing you did for me, okay?"

Lu Fan squeezed the jade pendant in his hand tightly and said, "Don't worry, we have never dated."

After speaking, Lu Fan slammed the jade pendant in his hand to the ground.Zhang Yuehan's eyes flickered, but she did not pick up the jade pendant. She took a few steps back and said, "Lu Fan, be realistic. You also know that it was impossible for us before. Goodbye."

Zhang Yuehan seemed unwilling to say another word to Lu Fan and left quickly.

Lu Fan looked at her back, unable to overlap the lovely woman who was beside him with the woman in front of him.

Zhang Yuehan never said this when she was with him.She didn't say this when he secretly gave her the medicinal ingredients that he couldn't bear to take.

Lu Fan stood there for a long time, and suddenly snow fell from the sky.

Lu Fan walked back to the square in despair. At this time, others were still having fun testing.

Suddenly, Lu Fan saw Zhang Yuehan chatting and laughing with his cousin Lu Ming in the distance, and at this time, Lu Ming actually gave her his sword, and Zhang Yuehan accepted it happily with a hint of shyness.

With infinite sadness rising in his heart, Lu Fan chuckled and turned around to leave.
